report.title: Invalid amount not detected
report.summary: The page did not detect an invalid amount, allowing a non-numeric value to be submitted. This is a security risk.
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Go to the Bill Pay page
2. Fill in a valid payee and address
3. Enter a non-numeric value in the Amount field
report.expected: The page should detect the invalid amount and display an error message
report.actual: The page allowed the non-numeric value to be submitted and did not display an error message
evidence: Locator expected to be visible Actual value: None Error: element(s) not found
report.suspected_cause: The page's validation logic may be faulty.
report.next_action: The development team should review the page's validation logic and fix the issue to prevent security risks.
